title: Stretching Your Style: Everyday Tips to Keep Your Cut Neat from 3D Cutz, Norwich
description: Practical, easy-to-follow tips from 3D Cutz in Norwich on caring for your haircut between visits — washing, styling, small upkeep and product choices.

content.heading: Start with a cut that suits your routine
paragraphs: The easiest way to make a haircut last is to get one that matches how you live. Tell your barber how long you want to go between visits and they can adjust the length, blending and tapering so the style ages gracefully.
If you prefer lower maintenance, ask for slightly more length on top and softer transitions at the sides — these hide regrowth and keep the shape looking intentional rather than overgrown.

content.heading: Wash and condition with care
paragraphs: Washing daily can strip natural oils and make hair look limp; most people do fine with every other day or a few times a week depending on hair type. Use a gentle shampoo and apply conditioner mainly to the mid-lengths and ends to keep hair healthy without flattening the cut.
When you rinse, a cooler finish helps close the hair cuticle for shine and hold. Pat hair dry with a towel instead of rubbing to avoid frizz and unnecessary breakage that ruins a crisp outline.

content.heading: Style smartly and protect overnight
paragraphs: Use small amounts of lightweight, water-based products to refresh shape without buildup. Dry shampoo is useful between washes to absorb oil at the roots and restore texture; heavy waxes and greasy pomades will weigh styles down more quickly.
Minimise heat where possible and sleep on a simple, smooth pillowcase to reduce friction. A quick comb-through in the morning and a light restyle will often keep a cut looking tidy for days.

content.heading: Do small upkeep — or ask for a quick tidy
paragraphs: A careful trim of flyaways with scissors or a neat-up of the neckline with a trimmer can extend the life of a cut, but only attempt these if you’re comfortable — it’s easy to remove too much. Keep tools clean and go slowly.

If you'd rather leave it to a pro, pop into 3D Cutz at 19 Prince of Wales Road, Norwich NR1 1BD for personalised advice or a quick tidy. Your barber can show you simple at-home steps tailored to your style.
